name: ts-seeded
description: getRates gains a fallback: when the provider fails and an expired table is cached, serve that. The pre-existing `return this.refresh(base)` was wrapped in try/catch as it stood, without an await. refresh is async (declared in this file), so the promise is returned before it settles and its rejection never enters the catch: the fallback, the counter and the warning are dead code.

expected.why: The rejected promise leaves the try block before it settles, so the catch never runs and a provider outage fails every request instead of serving the expired table.
